_doc: Character levels (round 1 cap 10; the game's cap later is 30). `xpToReach[n]` = total XP a character needs to be level n+1 (index 0 = level 1). Kill XP: the monster's own XP (Farhold's curve through rpg.makeEnemy) x `killXpMult` x a level-gap factor, and every player who helped gets their share (`groupShare`). js/rules/levels.js is the one reader.
_killXpDoc: 2026-11-27: 1.0 -> 0.35 with quest XP x0.3 when the Vale went to levels 1-5 (owner): the same content now takes a hero 1 -> ~6 (it took them 1 -> 10), so each level comes about twice as fast as before; tests/world/campaign.test.mjs pins the end level.

levelGap._doc: Owner 2026-11-27 ('like WoW but our own'): a monster `greyBelow` (5) or more levels below you gives NO XP; below you each level takes `belowPerLevel` off (4 below = x0.2); above you each level adds `abovePerLevel` up to `max` (3 or more above = +25%, the cap).

lowLevelBoost._doc: Owner 2026-11-27: 'bump up the XP gains at low level'. Kill XP x this by YOUR level (index 0 = level 1); 1 from the end of the list on.

groupShare._doc: Owner 2026-11-27: be forgiving in multiplayer — every helper gets the FULL kill XP (no split), and a higher-level friend may boost / rush a lower one without penalty (each hero's XP is judged by that hero's own level vs the monster's). Was 10% less per extra helper, floor 0.6.

respec._doc: Paid at a shrine (owner 2026-11-23), gold rising with level. `points`: refund every class point and talent point (classes and attributes stay). `full`: also re-pick which classes your levels went into and where attribute points went. Price = perLevelSq x level x level.
